Puerto Nariño · Colombian Amazon

Cultural encounters in the Amazon

Meet the region through craft, everyday life and the stories of its people.

Ask Amaru on WhatsApp ↗

About this experience

Discover the region through local stories, everyday life and the knowledge that hosts choose to share. These cultural encounters focus on people and exchange, rather than a wildlife outing. Visits depend on the hosts’ availability and wishes; approach as a guest, ask permission for photographs and follow their guidance.

Puerto Nariño is also a place of living cultures, including the Ticuna, Cocama and Yagua peoples. That diversity is part of understanding the Colombian Amazon alongside its rivers and forests. A cultural encounter offers time to listen to the people who live here and to approach the region through everyday life, local knowledge and the stories they choose to share.

Come with curiosity and room for an exchange. Ask what your hosts would like to tell you and follow their lead about photographs and participation. Each encounter depends on the people receiving you; confirm who will host the visit and what they wish to share, without assuming a particular community, ceremony or demonstration.

Destination context sources: Colombia Travel ↗

What to explore

  • Local stories and cultural encounters
  • Host-led visits, subject to availability
  • Respect for customs and permission for portraits

Levels are indicative. Terrain, water levels, weather and your group can change the demands of an outing.

Request permission before taking portraits or recording conversations. Ask about local customs and any limits on visits, photographs or activities. Confirm the host, language and content of the encounter with Amaru. If you are interested in crafts or particular traditions, mention it as a question when enquiring, rather than an expected inclusion.

What should I confirm?

Ask about the route, departure, group requirements, guide language, equipment, transport and what is included. Share your dates and number of travellers, and review the full price and cancellation conditions before confirming anything.

Routes depend on water levels, weather and local conditions. Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed.
